summary: Backend-only testing of the iteration-8 /api/payments/checkout 3-attempt Stripe fallback fix. Added 9 new pytest tests (TestCheckoutFallbackChain + TestNoLegacyMessage) in /app/backend/tests/test_stripe_diagnostics.py using an in-process TestClient with monkeypatched stripe.Price.list and stripe.checkout.Session.create (a call-counting stub that raises/returns per attempt). Full suite: 72 passed, 1 failed (72/73 = 98.6%). All 8 requested scenarios verified: attempt-1 success (200 + payment_transactions row with plan=pro, amount=2900, currency=usd), attempt-2 automatic_tax success (200, kwargs include automatic_tax + billing_address_collection=required), attempt-3 bare-bones success (200, no managed_payments/automatic_tax kwargs), all-three-fail -> 400 'Stripe rejected the checkout: <real user_message>', admin-coupon 'No such coupon' surfaced verbatim with discounts=[{coupon: BAD_COUPON_ID}] and no allow_promotion_codes, RateLimitError/APIConnectionError on attempt 1 -> 400 'Stripe error: <real message>', no payment_transactions row inserted on failure, all 63 prior tests still pass (incl. the actionable lookup_key/setup_stripe.py no-price message), and the string 'Could not start checkout' no longer exists anywhere in server.py.

minor.issue: Fallback gap: a non-InvalidRequestError StripeError (RateLimitError, APIConnectionError, CardError, etc.) raised by ATTEMPT 2 or ATTEMPT 3 is not caught anywhere — the nested try blocks only catch InvalidRequestError, and the outer `except stripe.error.StripeError` cannot catch exceptions raised inside its sibling except-block. Result: exception escapes to FastAPI -> HTTP 500 'Internal Server Error' with no actionable message, i.e. the exact class of silent-swallow the fix was meant to remove. Repro test: TestCheckoutFallbackChain::test_non_invalidrequest_stripe_error_on_second_attempt (currently FAILING by design). Suggested fix: wrap the whole 3-attempt chain in a helper (loop over kwargs variants) with a single `except stripe.error.StripeError` at the end, or add `except stripe.error.StripeError as e2b/e3b: raise HTTPException(400, f'Stripe error: {...}')` to the inner blocks.

action_items: Handle non-InvalidRequestError StripeError raised by checkout fallback attempts 2 and 3 (currently 500 instead of 400 with the real message) — see minor issue / failing test test_non_invalidrequest_stripe_error_on_second_attempt.
critical_code_review_comments: create_checkout's nested try/except pyramid duplicates the Session.create call 3x; refactor into a list of kwarg variants iterated in a loop with one StripeError handler — removes duplication and closes the attempt-2/3 StripeError hole.
server.py is ~1425 lines; consider splitting payments/admin/workspace routers into modules (>700-line guideline).
Attempt 2's warning log uses f'{e2}' while attempt 1 lowercases user_message into an unused `msg` variable — dead code; log e.user_message consistently.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run tests from /app/backend/tests (`cd /app/backend/tests && python -m pytest . -q`); there is no pytest.ini and conftest is imported by module name so cwd matters. STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is blank in backend/.env, so all real-Stripe paths are exercised in-process via TestClient with monkeypatched stripe.api_key/Price.list/checkout.Session.create. The _SessionCreateStub helper in test_stripe_diagnostics.py records per-attempt kwargs — reuse it for any further checkout-fallback work. Only known failure is the attempt-2/3 non-InvalidRequestError StripeError gap; that test should pass once the main agent fixes the handler.
rca_of_the_issue: The reported fix works for the InvalidRequestError chain and for non-InvalidRequestError StripeError on the first call. The remaining hole is Python except-clause scoping: exceptions raised inside `except stripe.error.InvalidRequestError` blocks (attempts 2 and 3) bypass the sibling `except stripe.error.StripeError` handler, so a transient RateLimit/APIConnection failure on a retry still produces an opaque 500.
